quests.instruction: Coconuts, guavas, and lychees all belong to the same fruit category. Which one is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit rarely grows in places with cold winters.
quests.explanation: Super! Coconuts, guavas, and lychees all belong to this warm-weather fruit category, called tropical fruit!
quests.funFact: Tropical fruits grow in hot, humid climates near the equator.

quests.instruction: Oranges, lemons, and limes all belong to the same fruit category. What is it called?
quests.hint: This category of fruit usually has a thick peel and juicy, tangy sections inside.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Oranges, lemons, and limes all belong to this juicy, tangy fruit category, called citrus fruit!
quests.funFact: Citrus fruits have a thick, leathery rind and juicy segments inside.

quests.instruction: A wrinkly prune and a chewy raisin are both examples of fruit changed by this process. What is it?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit changed by time, heat, or sun until it's chewy and small.
quests.explanation: You found it! A wrinkly prune and chewy raisin are both examples of fruit changed this way, called dried fruit!
quests.funFact: Dried fruit has had almost all of its water removed.

quests.instruction: Mangoes, pineapples, and papayas all belong to the same fruit category. What is it called?
quests.hint: This category of fruit usually grows in hot, sunny places near the equator.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Mangoes, pineapples, and papayas all belong to this warm-climate fruit category, called tropical fruit!
quests.funFact: Mangoes, bananas, and pineapples are all tropical fruits.

quests.instruction: A raisin and a dried date are both fruits that lost nearly all their water this way. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit made smaller and chewier on purpose.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! A raisin and a dried date are both fruits that lost nearly all their water this way, called dried fruit!
quests.funFact: Raisins are just dried grapes, and prunes are dried plums.

quests.instruction: Pears, plums, and oranges all belong to the same fruit category, based on their growing spot. Which one is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit is found in an orchard, growing from tall, woody trunks.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Pears, plums, and oranges all belong to this orchard fruit category, called tree fruit!
quests.funFact: Tree fruits grow on the branches of large, woody plants.

quests.instruction: Watermelons, cantaloupes, and honeydews all belong to the same fruit category. What is it called?
quests.hint: This category of fruit usually grows big, round, and mostly full of water.
quests.explanation: Yes! Watermelons, cantaloupes, and honeydews all belong to this big, watery fruit category, called melon!
quests.funFact: Melons are large, heavy fruits that grow on vines trailing along the ground.

quests.instruction: Mangoes, cherries, and pears all belong to the same fruit category, based on how they grow. Which is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit grows from branches high above the ground, not close to the soil.
quests.explanation: That's right! Mangoes, cherries, and pears all belong to this above-ground fruit category, called tree fruit!
quests.funFact: Apples, pears, and cherries are classic tree fruits.

quests.instruction: Dried figs and dried apricots are both fruits preserved by removing this one key ingredient. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit preserved by taking away its natural liquid.
quests.explanation: Great job! Dried figs and dried apricots are both fruits preserved by removing water, called dried fruit!
quests.funFact: Drying fruit makes it last for months without going bad.

quests.instruction: Grapefruits, tangerines, and kumquats all belong to the same fruit category. Which one is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit often grows in warm, sunny places.
quests.explanation: You got it! Grapefruits, tangerines, and kumquats all belong to this fruit category, called citrus fruit!
quests.funFact: Oranges, lemons, and grapefruits are all citrus fruits.

quests.instruction: Apples, figs, and apricots all belong to the same fruit category, based on their growing habit. What's it called?
quests.hint: This category of fruit needs years of patient growing before its very first harvest.
quests.explanation: Well done! Apples, figs, and apricots all belong to this patient-growing fruit category, called tree fruit!
quests.funFact: Many tree fruits take several years before the tree is mature enough to produce them.

quests.instruction: Raisins and dried apricots are both grapes and apricots that went through the same process. Which word matches?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit shrunk down after losing most of its natural water.
quests.explanation: Correct! Raisins and dried apricots are both fruits shrunk down this way, called dried fruit!
quests.funFact: Dried fruit is a perfect, sweet snack to take on a long hike.

quests.instruction: Cherries, peaches, and apricots all belong to the same fruit category. What's it called?
quests.hint: This category of fruit is named after the hard part right at its core.
quests.explanation: Super! Cherries, peaches, and apricots all belong to this hard-core fruit category, called stone fruit!
quests.funFact: Stone fruits have a single, large, rock-hard pit in the center.

quests.instruction: Currants, blackberries, and strawberries all belong to the same fruit category. What is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit is small, soft, and usually eaten fresh in just one bite.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Currants, blackberries, and strawberries all belong to this small, soft fruit category, called berry!
quests.funFact: Berries are small, juicy fruits that do not have a stone pit.

quests.instruction: A sweet cantaloupe and a juicy honeydew both belong to the same fruit category. Which is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit usually needs to be cut with a big knife, not peeled by hand.
quests.explanation: You found it! A sweet cantaloupe and juicy honeydew both belong to this big-knife fruit category, called melon!
quests.funFact: They have a thick rind and are incredibly juicy inside.

quests.instruction: Apricots, plums, and cherries all belong to the same fruit category. Which one is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit shares one single hard part, unlike a fruit with tiny seeds.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Apricots, plums, and cherries all belong to this single-pit fruit category, called stone fruit!
quests.funFact: Peaches, plums, and cherries are all stone fruits.

quests.instruction: Blackberries, gooseberries, and currants all belong to the same fruit category. Which one is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit is often picked by the handful from a bush.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Blackberries, gooseberries, and currants all belong to this handful-picked fruit category, called berry!
quests.funFact: Strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries are famous berries.

quests.instruction: Cherries, plums, and mangoes all belong to the same fruit category, based on how they grow. Which one is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit hangs from tall, woody branches.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Cherries, plums, and mangoes all belong to this tall, branch-grown fruit category, called tree fruit!
quests.funFact: Fruit trees must be pruned carefully to produce the best fruit.

quests.instruction: Peaches, plums, and cherries all belong to the same fruit category. What is it called?
quests.hint: This category of fruit always has one single hard pit in the center.
quests.explanation: Yes! Peaches, plums, and cherries all belong to this single-pit fruit category, called stone fruit!
quests.funFact: The hard pit protects the single seed resting safely inside.

quests.instruction: Grapefruits, clementines, and limes all belong to the same fruit category. What is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit almost always has a bright color to match its famous reputation.
quests.explanation: That's right! Grapefruits, clementines, and limes all belong to this bright fruit category, called citrus fruit!
quests.funFact: They are packed with massive amounts of Vitamin C.

quests.instruction: Mulberries, blueberries, and cranberries all belong to the same fruit category. Which is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit is usually small enough to grab by the handful.
quests.explanation: Great job! Mulberries, blueberries, and cranberries all belong to this handful fruit category, called berry!
quests.funFact: They are often used to make sweet jams and jellies.

quests.instruction: Dragon fruit, star fruit, and rambutan all belong to the same fruit category. What's it called?
quests.hint: This category of fruit often has an unusual, exotic look.
quests.explanation: You got it! Dragon fruit, star fruit, and rambutan all belong to this exotic fruit category, called tropical fruit!
quests.funFact: These fruits cannot survive freezing winter temperatures.

quests.instruction: A big watermelon and a sweet cantaloupe both belong to the same fruit category. What's it called?
quests.hint: This category of fruit is usually the biggest one at a summer picnic.
quests.explanation: Well done! A big watermelon and sweet cantaloupe both belong to this big fruit category, called melon!
quests.funFact: Cantaloupe and honeydew are very popular types of melon.

quests.instruction: Pomelos, mandarins, and lemons all belong to the same fruit category. What's it called?
quests.hint: This category of fruit is known for its zesty, fragrant outer peel.
quests.explanation: Correct! Pomelos, mandarins, and lemons all belong to this zesty fruit category, called citrus fruit!
quests.funFact: Citrus fruits need a lot of warm sunshine to grow properly.

quests.instruction: Raisins, dried apricots, and prunes are all fruits prepared the same special way. What is that way called?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit that's had almost all of its water removed.
quests.explanation: Super! Raisins, dried apricots, and prunes are all fruits with their water removed, called dried fruit!
quests.funFact: Did you know? dried fruit has had almost all of its water removed.

quests.instruction: Lemons, tangerines, and kumquats all belong to the same fruit category. What is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit often has an outer peel packed with fragrant oil.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Lemons, tangerines, and kumquats all belong to this fragrant fruit category, called citrus fruit!
quests.funFact: Did you know? citrus fruits have a thick, leathery rind and juicy segments inside.

quests.instruction: Strawberries, currants, and mulberries all belong to the same fruit category. What is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit is small and soft enough to pop in one bite.
quests.explanation: You found it! Strawberries, currants, and mulberries all belong to this small, soft fruit category, called berry!
quests.funFact: Birds love to eat wild berries growing on bushes.

quests.instruction: Dates, apricots, and nectarines all belong to the same fruit category. What is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit is easy to spot once you reach its firm, hard middle.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Dates, apricots, and nectarines all belong to this firm-middle fruit category, called stone fruit!
quests.funFact: They usually ripen very quickly in the middle of summer.

quests.instruction: Blueberries, raspberries, and gooseberries all belong to the same fruit category. Which is it?
quests.hint: This category of fruit usually grows low, on a small bush or vine.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Blueberries, raspberries, and gooseberries all belong to this low-growing fruit category, called berry!
quests.funFact: Did you know? berries are small, juicy fruits that do not have a stone pit.

quests.instruction: Dried cherries and dried pineapple rings are both fruit prepared this chewy, long-lasting way. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes fruit made to last much longer on the shelf.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Dried cherries and dried pineapple rings are both fruit made long-lasting this way, called dried fruit!
quests.funFact: Did you know? raisins are just dried grapes, and prunes are dried plums.
